photos.desc: Oxyuranus microlepidotus at the Universeum Science Park in Gothenburg, Sweden.
Photo of Inland Taipan taken at Shoalhaven Zoo in March 2016. The colour is distinctly yellow/very light brown. Colour is probably the snakes summer colour because of the warming of it's enclosure.
Taken at Sydney Wildlife World, Darling Harbour.
